web_description_html: Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg (NPN 80098765) - a chelated vegetable capsule formulated for optimal tolerability.
marketplace_bullets: Supports muscle and bone health with 200 mg magnesium bisglycinate (NPN 80098765), a chelated form for gentle absorption.
Vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO vegetable capsule ideal for consistent daily intake.
Helps maintain proper muscle function, including the heart muscle, through natural magnesium delivery.
Take 1 to 2 capsules, 1 to 2 times daily for sustained support of energy metabolism and tissue formation.
May cause mild diarrhea in some users; consult a health care practitioner if pregnant or breastfeeding (NPN 80098765).
social_post_copy: Gentle, effective support for your body starts here. Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg (NPN 80098765) provides chelated magnesium for muscle, bone, and energy needs. Vegan, gluten-free, and non-GMO. Take 1–2 capsules, 1–2 times daily. #NaturalHealth #MagnesiumSupport
